Exterminate the [[Margonite]]s that feast on the souls of the departed.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Meet [[Jehner]] in the [[Poisoned Outcrops]].
* Destroy the soul-eating [[Margonite]]s. You have X of 5 groups remaining.
* See Jehner for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]]
* 30 [[Lightbringer Promotion Points]]
* [[Ancient Artifact]]

==Walkthrough==
Just follow the markers and kill the [[Margonite]] groups. Some groups might be killed for you by the roaming [[Djinn]]s and [[Awakened]].

==NPCs==
===Allies===

*{{mo}} 20 [[Freed Soul]] (seven of them in total as the quest progresses)

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Jehner
:''"One would think that in death, all of life's problems would be solved...Well, at least we don't have to pay taxes.''
:''We have decided to band together and eliminate the soul-devouring '''Margonite''' threat once and for all. We're headed for the '''Poisoned Outcrops''' to root them out. Will you join us?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = The only good Margonite is a dead Margonite.
|decline = Can't you ghosts do anything on your own?
|ask = Meet us in the '''Poisoned Outcrops''' and we'll teach those '''Margonites''' a lesson. }}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Jehner
:''"Let's get moving; those Margonites aren't going to just give up without a fight."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Jehner
:''"Here, take this. I found it on the bodies of one of those foul monsters we killed. Maybe you can pay your taxes with it? Ha ha ha!"''

==Notes==
* Jehner and several Freed Souls will join you as allies on this quest. Although quest completion does not require their survival, if you keep Jehner alive, you can avoid the need to return to The Ruptured Heart to claim the reward. 
* Jehner and the Freed Souls will stop following your party when the quest is completed. If you are using them as meat shields or general allies in a vanquish, it may be advantageous to save one group of Margonite Souleaters for last.
* The Margonite Souleaters are hostile to both normal Margonites and the Awakened.
* As the Souleaters spawn when you zone into the instance, it is possible to start from [[Lair of the Forgotten]] and backtrack to kill the groups without talking to Jehner, effectively making the quest shorter as you don't need to walk from the quest start location to Poisoned Outcrops as well as guaranteeing his survival making claiming the reward easier.
